accomplishment.definitionKo: 많은 사람들을 위하여 힘을 들여 이루어 놓은 훌륭한 일.
accomplishment.englishDescription: An admirable work achieved with effort on behalf of many people.

accomplishment.definitionKo: 반대나 방해를 견뎌 내고 목적을 이루어 냄.
accomplishment.englishDescription: The act of achieving a goal after enduring opposition or disturbance.
A state in which a person has achieved a goal.

accomplishment.definitionKo: 뜻한 대로 일이 이루어짐. 또는 일을 이룸.
accomplishment.englishDescription: The act of achieving something as one wanted, or an achievement.

accomplishment.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 분야에서 실제로 이룬 업적.
accomplishment.englishDescription: An actual result in a certain job or field.

accomplishment.englishDescription: Results that one achieves through endeavor and hard work in business, research, etc.

accomplishment.englishDescription: The state of achieving or fulfilling one's goal or duties.
Tasks done or achievements made during one's lifetime.
The act of achieving something that one has aimed for.

alga.definitionKo: 물속에 살면서 엽록소로 광합성을 하며, 꽃이 피지 않고 포자로 번식하는 식물.
alga.englishDescription: An aquatic plant that photosynthesizes with chlorophyll, does not produce flowers and reproduces with spores.

economy.definitionKo: 매매나 거래에 나타나는 호황, 불황과 같이 경제 분야에 관련되어 나타나는 상황.
economy.englishDescription: Conditions related to economic areas such as booms and recessions in trade or transactions.

economy.definitionKo: 생산이나 소비 등과 관련된 사람들의 활동. 또는 한 사회나 국가에서 돈, 자원, 산업, 생산, 소비, 무역 등과 관련된 모든 활동.
economy.englishDescription: Activities related to production or consumption; or all the activities related to money, resources, production, consumption, trade, etc., in a society or nation.

geureonjeuk.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '그러한즉' (a conjugated form of '그러하다' (be so)).

lane.definitionKo: 차가 한 줄로 정해진 부분을 통행하도록 차선으로 구분한 찻길의 부분.
lane.englishDescription: A part of a roadway for use by a single line of vehicles, designated by a line painted on the road.

lane.definitionKo: 육상이나 수영 등의 경기에서, 각각의 선수가 나아가는 길.
lane.englishDescription: In a sports game such as an athletic meet or swimming meet, the path where each player runs or swims.

lane.definitionKo: 볼링에서, 공을 굴리게 되어 있는 바닥.

lane.definitionKo: 차가 한 줄로 정해진 부분을 통행하도록 차선으로 구분한 찻길의 부분.
lane.englishDescription: A part of a roadway for use by a single line of vehicles, designated by a line painted on the road.

persimmon.definitionKo: 둥글거나 둥글넓적하며 익기 전에는 떫지만 익으면 단맛이 나는 주황색 과일.
persimmon.englishDescription: An orange-colored, round or roundish flat fruit, which is astringent when unripe but sweet when ripe.

pledge.definitionKo: 정부, 정당, 입후보자 등이 앞으로 어떤 일을 하겠다고 국민에게 약속함. 또는 그런 약속.
pledge.englishDescription: A government, political party, candidate, etc., promising to achieve certain things for the people, or such a promise.

pledge.definitionKo: 정부, 정당, 입후보자 등이 앞으로 어떤 일을 하겠다고 국민에게 약속하다.

pledge.englishDescription: An act of agreeing with someone to do a certain thing, or details of such an agreement.

pledge.englishDescription: The act of making certain that one has done or will do something.
The act of making a vow to keep a promise.
To make a vow to keep a promise.

pledge.definitionKo: 다른 사람과 어떤 일을 하기로 미리 정하다.
pledge.englishDescription: To agree with someone to do a certain thing.

To promise to do something definitely.

pop-eyed.definitionKo: 놀라거나 무서워서 크게 뜬 눈이 둥그렇다.
pop-eyed.englishDescription: Wide-open eyes being large and round, being frightened or scared by something.

pop-eyed.definitionKo: 놀라거나 무서워서 크게 뜬 눈이 매우 둥글다.

search.definitionKo: 무엇을 찾기 위해서 여기저기를 살피다.

search.englishDescription: To search thoroughly for a person, object, etc.

search.definitionKo: 검사나 경찰이 범인이나 증거물 등을 찾기 위해 집, 물건, 사람의 신체 등을 강제로 조사하다.

search.definitionKo: 무엇을 찾거나 알아보다.

search.definitionKo: 학문 등을 깊이 파고들어 연구함.
search.englishDescription: An act of digging into and looking into a field of study, etc., deeply.

search.definitionKo: 알려지지 않은 사물이나 현상을 찾아내거나 밝히기 위해 살피어 찾음.

search.englishDescription: To probe and look around, in an attempt to discover an unknown object or reveal an unknown phenomenon.
